title: 4⁴ Breath (APK)
blurb: Native Android APK implementing the 4-4-4-4 box breathing protocol with visual timing cues, haptic feedback, and offline-first operation.
description: 4⁴ Breath is the Android edition of the 4⁴ box-breathing clock. The web page preserves the existing APK as an inert inspectable package while providing a browser-native JavaScript parity layer for smooth web execution of the breathing workflow.
author: [0xdeadbeef] of ZZX-Labs R&D

capabilities.name: Haptic cues
capabilities.notes: Vibration API support varies by browser/device.

capabilities.name: Wake lock
capabilities.notes: Screen Wake Lock API where available.

capabilities.name: APK hosted-file loading
capabilities.notes: Loads same-origin APK as inert binary data.

capabilities.name: APK local-file loading
capabilities.notes: User-selected APK remains inside browser memory.

capabilities.name: APK signature-material detection
capabilities.notes: Detects legacy META-INF signature entries and APK Signing Block magic.

capabilities.name: DEX/APK execution
capabilities.notes: Ordinary browser sandboxes do not execute Android DEX/APK code; functionality runs through the browser parity layer instead.
